data.one_liner: A clean and lightweight progress HUD to show a running asynchronous task for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a progress heads-up display (HUD) widget and popup for Flutter to indicate running asynchronous tasks. Supports labels, detail labels, progress values, and cancellation.
use_when: You need to show a loading spinner or progress indicator during async network requests.
You want to display overlay HUD popups or wrap widgets with an embedded progress HUD.
avoid_when: You need complex state management architectures rather than a UI progress indicator.
strengths: Supports both widget-based HUD and popup-based HUD.
Allows custom labels, detail text, and progress values.
weaknesses: Limited built-in features beyond standard progress HUD requirements.
Documentation outside the README is minimal.
